focusGuide.Data Structures: Master asymptotic notation, sorting/search complexity, and trace small algorithms by hand.
focusGuide.Java / OOP: Review constructors, interfaces, exceptions, GC, and Java language restrictions.
focusGuide.Database: Practice normalization, keys, FDs, ER diagrams, and SQL semantics.
focusGuide.Networking: Know OSI/TCP layers, protocols, subnetting, and topology tradeoffs.
focusGuide.Security: Study Saltzer-Schroeder principles, CIA triad, PKI, and malware types.
focusGuide.Project Management: Learn lifecycle models, risk strategies, WBS, and critical path.
focusGuide.AI / ML: Classify learning types and search algorithms (BFS, DFS, UCS, A*, greedy).
focusGuide.Software Engineering: SRS properties, requirements engineering, maintenance, and testing process.
focusGuide.Operating Systems: Process/thread lifecycle, scheduling, memory management, deadlock.
focusGuide.Web Development: CSS selectors, HTTP methods/status codes, DOM, and JavaScript basics.
focusGuide.Android: Activity/Intent/Service rules, manifest, lifecycle, and APK structure.
focusGuide.C++: Trace loops for complexity, valid syntax, compilation stages.
focusGuide.Software Architecture: Quality attributes, layered architecture, coupling, ATAM scenarios.
focusGuide.Software Testing: Test levels, coverage, traceability, and defect lifecycle.
focusGuide.General: Review lecture notes for any remaining topics.
